title: myrcia krugioides
intro: Myrcia krugioides, commonly known as "guabiroba", is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of South America and is valued for its medicinal and nutritional properties. The health benefits of Myrcia krugioides include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
